meta.partial_note: 2026-09-11: queries repointed to the columns the Comtrak API populates on every row — ESF/PSF 'Est Weekly Spread' (was 'Est Spread'/'Weekly Spread'), 'AM' (was 'Account Manager'), Contact Activity 'Owner' (was 'AM'), Recruiter Activity COALESCE(Employee, Record Id). Starts/pending/dump-in/lock-up/forecast/raffle rebuilt on the corrected columns. Close ratio, meetings, subs and hours still carried forward from 2026-09-10: their source tables lag (Close Ratio ends 8/26, Recruiter Activity 8/31, Hours 8/24).

company.weekly_spread_basis: Comtrak Raw – Spread (API), Office Manager rows (every placement once at 100%), all hours types

fill_ratio.basis: Comtrak Raw - Close Ratio Details, windowed on Status Date (the date the req moved to Closed); ratio = filled / (filled + lost + washed), pooled for the company tile
fill_ratio.retired_basis: AM Productivity Snapshot / Coverage Date - filled reqs carry a 2038-01-31 sentinel date and fell outside every window
